name: TopologyViewToggle
description: "View as list" / "View as map": in the map's controls, and in the list's toolbar.
signature: ({ view, onViewChange, size }: { view: TopologyView; onViewChange: (view: TopologyView) => void; size?: "sm" | "md"; }): import("react").JSX.Element

props.name: onViewChange
props.description: Called with the view the person switches to.

props.name: size
props.description: The token-based size. Touch targets adapt to coarse pointers independently of the selected density.

props.name: view
props.description: The view currently shown; the button offers the other one (an icon button on the map, "View as map" in the list).
